faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Assistant position at Gurugram University?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Research Assistant position is 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class M. Pharm. in Pharmaceutical Chemistry with a minimum of 60% marks or an equivalent CGPA.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Gurugram University Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email with all required documents attached before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for General/OBC categories in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Assistant position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview date for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The interview for the Research Assistant position is scheduled for 03 September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of Gurugram University?
faq.answer: The official website of Gurugram University is www.gurugramuniversity.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at Gurugram University.
